latHint: Think a large bird of prey with sharp eyesight.
pivHint: David asks God to RENEW a steady spirit within him. Isaiah says those who hope in the Lord RENEW their strength and rise up like the ______.
winText: You found it. RENEW isn't just David's plea for a steady spirit. Isaiah says those who hope in the Lord RENEW their strength and soar like the EAGLE.
lossText: The word was EAGLE. RENEW was the pivot. Isaiah 40:31 promises that those who hope in the Lord will RENEW their strength and soar high like the EAGLE.
votdVerse: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
passageText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me. Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.
